fresh_A0_vs_recorded_A0_P3.protocol_match: UNVERIFIED (recorded A0 harness script absent; decode/generation parameters unknown)
fresh_A0_vs_recorded_A0_P3.operating_point_note: THE RECORDED A0 ARTIFACT IS A *GATED* OPERATING POINT, NOT A MODEL-QUALITY MEASUREMENT. Recorded A0 abstained on 27/42 unanswerable (64.3%) at the cost of 78/140 answerable false abstentions (55.7%), which suppresses its answerable EM/F1 by construction. The fresh A0 pass uses the identical pinned decode with NO abstention gate and measures EM 5.0 / F1 24.4. The two numbers therefore describe different operating points of the same checkpoint; neither alone is 'the' A0 performance. Notably the fresh ungated A0 (5.0/24.4) exceeds the fresh F2 (2.9/19.7) on this population, so the recorded-artifact impression that F2 > A0 is an operating-point artifact, not a verified model ranking.

dominant_observed_failure.scope: answerable incorrect examples only (n=136); unanswerable handled separately
dominant_observed_failure.interpretation_guard: This is a model-evaluation finding about this checkpoint on this population. It does not prove or disprove any architecture hypothesis (H-A..H-E).

key_findings.1_protocol_reproduced_exactly: Fresh F2 pass reproduced the recorded F2 predictions on 182/182 examples (predicted-answer string match 100%; null_score within 1e-4 on 182/182, max abs diff 2e-06). The recorded F2/G numbers are reproducible under the pinned protocol.
key_findings.2_dominant_model_only_failure: Structural/table handling dominates: TABLE_FAILURE 38 of 136 incorrect answerable examples, followed by SPAN_SELECTION 24 and LIST_FAILURE 17. Every table-cell, table-row, list-item, section-specific and multi-chunk example fails EM (0.0%); only DIRECT_SPAN (12.5% EM, 47.4% F1) and NUMERIC (5.0% EM, 39.8% F1) produce EM-correct answers.
key_findings.3_production_operating_point: Under an identical abstention-free decode, production A0 extracts better than F2 on P3 (EM 5.0 / F1 24.4 vs 2.9 / 19.7). The recorded A0 artifact (EM 2.1 / F1 12.0) reflects a gated operating point with 55.7% false abstention, so the dominant *system-level* loss for production is the abstention policy discarding 78/140 answerable questions - not the extraction itself.
key_findings.4_no_abstention_behaviour: Neither checkpoint abstained on any unanswerable example under sparse decode: F2 0/42 and A0 0/42 abstentions; both answered all 42 (spurious 42 = 23.1% of 182).
key_findings.5_confidence_separation: Confidence separates correct vs incorrect answerable predictions (AUC 0.811; correct mean 0.0436 vs incorrect 0.0303, 25 of 136 incorrect above the correct mean) but does NOT separate answerable vs unanswerable (null_score AUC 0.430).
key_findings.6_margin_ranking_vs_scale: Margin (null_score - best_answer_score) is CHECKPOINT-SPECIFIC in scale: F2 margins are negative for all 182 examples (max -0.2063, range (-3.1379, -0.2063)), so any 'abstain if margin >= t >= 0' rule abstains on nothing for F2 - consistent with the recorded G sweep reporting 0% abstention for every margin threshold. Production A0 differs: its margins reach +22.2717 (range (-10.653, 22.2717)) with 109/182 examples at margin >= 0, so a margin rule CAN fire for A0 even though it cannot for F2. Direction of separation is the same for both (unanswerable rank above answerable; F2 margin AUC 0.734), but the absolute scale - not the ranking - gates whether a margin policy can abstain at all.
key_findings.scope_guard: These are model-evaluation findings for these two checkpoints on the frozen P3 population. They do not prove or disprove any architecture hypothesis (H-A..H-E) and no threshold was tuned, fitted or selected in this evaluation.

7_margin_scale_comparison.note: Recorded fact only; no threshold was selected or tuned. This is presented as a measured difference between the two checkpoints' score scales on this population.
